sources_considered.why: Primary disclosure of available liquidity, lease commitments, and management's assessment of near-term funding.
Later financial position would not establish capacity at publication.

evidence_items.publisher: CoreWeave, SEC filing mirrored by Yahoo Finance
evidence_items.locator: Leases accounting policy; Liquidity and Capital Resources, pages 118–119; Note 8, page F-33
evidence_items.explanation: Reported liquidity was $5.767 billion, while estimated payments for leases not yet commenced totaled $15 billion over multiple years. Management expected existing resources and borrowing availability to cover obligations over the next year; neither statement reconciles the author's full construction estimate with payment dates.

metric_scope.metric: Reported liquidity and future lease commitments

unresolved_gaps: The searched records do not reconcile the extrapolated buildout cost with binding construction obligations.
Payment timing, future contractual receipts, and restrictions on borrowing availability are not combined into a complete funding schedule.
